record.original_question: Given a group Γ, determine all pairs (k, n) with k ≥ 1 and n ≥ 3 for which Γ occurs as the automorphism group of a k-orbit polytope or of a k-orbit maniplex of rank n.

evidence.quote: Problem 11. Given a group Γ, what are the numbers k ≥ 1 and n ≥ 3 such that Γ is the automorphism group of a k-orbit polytope or maniplex of rank n?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A maniplex of rank n (with n ≥ 3) is a connected n-valent simple graph whose edges are properly colored with the colors 0, 1, …, n−1 such that, for any two colors i and j with |i − j| ≥ 2, every connected subgraph induced by the edges of colors i and j is a 4-cycle; the vertices of a maniplex are called flags. Abstract n-polytopes correspond, via their flag graphs, to a subclass of rank-n maniplexes. An automorphism of a maniplex is a color-preserving graph automorphism, and the automorphism group acts freely on flags. A maniplex (or polytope) is called a k-orbit maniplex (resp. k-orbit polytope) if its automorphism group has exactly k orbits on flags.

Problem. Let Γ be an arbitrary group. Determine all pairs (k, n) with k ≥ 1 and n ≥ 3 such that there exists a k-orbit abstract polytope of rank n whose automorphism group is isomorphic to Γ, and determine all such pairs (k, n) for which there exists a k-orbit maniplex of rank n with automorphism group isomorphic to Γ.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing which groups arise as automorphism groups of k-orbit polytopes or maniplexes of a given rank remains active. Partial progress includes a characterization of automorphism groups of 3-orbit polyhedra (rank 3) and a general coset-geometry characterization of automorphism groups of k-orbit abstract polytopes by Cunningham, Pellicer, and collaborators, as well as constructions prescribing automorphism groups for convex polytopes. The full determination of all admissible (k, n) for a prescribed group Γ has not been completed.

status_evidence.title: All polytopes are coset geometries: Characterizing automorphism groups of k-orbit abstract polytopes
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizing automorphism groups of k-orbit abstract polytopes via coset geometries.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a general characterization framework, but does not resolve the (k,n) realization question for arbitrary Γ.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism groups of 3-orbit polyhedra
status_evidence.snippet: Determines necessary and sufficient conditions for 3-orbit polyhedra.
status_evidence.claim: Resolves the rank-3, k=3 case partially.

status_evidence.title: Prescribing Symmetries and Automorphisms for Polytopes
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions prescribing automorphism groups of convex and abstract polytopes.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on prescribing Γ, not a complete answer.
